summary: U.S. Physical Therapy filed a routine 8-K reporting entry into a 45-month forward-starting interest rate swap with Bank of America on September 22, 2026, initial notional $170.6 million, fixing the term-loan variable component at 4.578% per annum versus one-month SOFR. The swap starts June 30, 2027, when the existing swap expires, amortizes with the term loan under the April 14, 2026 Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, and terminates April 14, 2031. Bank of America also serves as Administrative Agent and lender. This is ordinary hedging, not a special situation; watch rate exposure and swap counterparty concentration.
